verdict.rationale: The pack documents pieces that sit near this workflow: chatting with the agent from Linear, running it headless in GitHub Actions, and Kanban cards with per-card worktrees and auto-commit. None of these documents taking a tracked issue and producing an opened pull request. These are building blocks or adjacent features that a user would have to wire together, not the issue-to-PR capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
